profile_text.body:
LangChain describes itself as an open agent engineering platform designed to let companies "own their intelligence," with a stated customer base of more than 7,000 organizations. The platform is positioned around building, controlling, and governing AI agents, and supports multiple model providers. The company presents its framework as offering a range of abstraction levels, from high-level, batteries-included tooling down to low-level control.

The site tracks two principal products. LangChain itself is an LLM application framework focused on agent orchestration, noted for rapid breaking changes and relevance to supply-chain risk considerations. LangSmith is a companion observability and governance platform covering tracing, evaluation, prompt versioning, and annotation queues; it supports OpenTelemetry ingest and is described as having the deepest integration with LangChain and LangGraph. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records appear in the held facts.
